claims.claim: Opens with Holmes injecting from bottle and syringe
claims.evidence: 'Sherlock Holmes took his bottle...hypodermic syringe from its neat morocco case'
'Which is it to-day?...morphine or cocaine' (Watson's protest)

claims.claim: Holmes reads Watson's brother's history from a watch
claims.evidence: Chapter I deduction from watch (read opening of the chapter; 'brother' appears)

claims.claim: Holmes is the only unofficial consulting detective
claims.evidence: 'The only unofficial consulting detective,' he answered

claims.claim: Mary Morstan receives a pearl every year
claims.evidence: 'every year upon the same date there has always appeared a similar box, containing a similar pearl'

claims.claim: Thaddeus Sholto tells of the Agra treasure
claims.evidence: Chapter IV 'The Story of the Bald-Headed Man'; 'Brother Bartholomew'; Agra treasure
'writhed his hands'; 'perpetual jerk'; 'An oasis of art'; 'hypochondriac'

claims.claim: Bartholomew is murdered at Pondicherry Lodge with a thorn
claims.evidence: 'Tragedy of Pondicherry Lodge'; 'It is a thorn'; 'the poison acts so quickly that the man was dead'
'Toby ran along'; 'Toby led us to the...wharf'

claims.claim: Chase of launch Aurora down the Thames
claims.evidence: 'The Aurora, sir'; 'the Aurora thundered on, and still we followed'

claims.claim: The killer's accomplice, Tonga, is shot
claims.evidence: Small: 'I'd have half killed Tonga'; Tonga, the black man, 'threw up his arms...fell sideways into the swirl'; Tonga is the one who killed Sholto; Small is the other
claims.fix: Tonga, the Andaman islander who made the kill, is shot

claims.evidence: 'we were able to haul him out'; 'You are under the charge of Mr. Athelney Jones'

claims.claim: He tells his story, but the treasure box is empty, thrown into river
claims.evidence: 'Small threw it into the Thames'; 'showed him the empty box'
claims.fix: The treasure chest is empty, for Small threw its contents into the river

claims.evidence: 'Miss Morstan has done me the honour to accept me as a husband in prospective'
'You are under the charge of Mr. Athelney Jones, of Scotland Yard'

claims.claim: Small is a convict seeking Agra treasure
claims.evidence: 'building a breakwater in the Andamans...Dartmoor'; 'Agra treasure'
